## Join our community

Following the practice of the RLadies+ Global, we manage event registration through the Meetup platform. If you are interested in attending our events, please join our Meetup group and RSVP at the corresponding event pages.

While we prioritize the representation of gender minorities in our community, we welcome all identities to participate in our events.

[{{< fa brands meetup >}} Meetup](https://www.meetup.com/rladies-vienna/){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
